prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the passenger in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has whiplash. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1448; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the sideswipe collision you were involved in. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just skip that part, if that's okay. You already have my file.

Q: I understand. For the record, can you confirm you were a passenger in the vehicle at the time of the collision?

A: Yes, I was in the front passenger seat. My brother was driving.

Q: Where were you traveling when this happened?

A: We were heading through Baytown on the main road, going toward the highway. It was a weekday afternoon, the traffic was moderate.

Q: Can you describe what happened immediately before the impact?

A: We were in the middle lane. The car next to us started drifting over, and then they cut into our lane while changing lanes. My brother tapped the brakes and tried to move right, but the sides of the cars still scraped together. It wasn't a big crash, more of a grinding sound and a hard jolt.

Q: Did you strike any part of the vehicle or your seat during the impact?

A: My head snapped forward and then back against the headrest. I didn't hit the dashboard or the window.

Q: When did you first notice pain or stiffness?

A: Right away I had a stiff neck, but by that evening it was worse. I have headaches now and I can't turn my head fully to the left.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care the next day and I've been seeing a physical therapist twice a week since then.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my medical bills covered, and I'm still having trouble sleeping because of the neck pain.

Q: Thank you for your time. This concludes the statement.
